The standard 52 deck of cards is dealt out equally. Each player makes bids of pieces 0-13; a successful null bid scores 100 and a failed null bid loses 100. Team contracts add up their non-null bids: they make the total for 10 points per bid, plus a bag for each extra piece; they fail and lose 10 points per bid. Every ten accumulated bags submit 100 points. Players must follow the suit they carry whenever possible. Spades cannot be carried until they are broken unless a player has only spades, and a spade outperforms any non-spade card.
